candidate_options.name: source_follower_or_preamp_buffer
candidate_options.purpose: make the sampled capacitor drive a small gate instead of the latch input pair directly
candidate_options.risk: adds offset, gain error, bias current, bandwidth limits, and its own input capacitance

candidate_options.name: sampled_comparator_input_capacitor
candidate_options.purpose: copy the held voltage onto a small internal decision capacitor before the latch clock moves
candidate_options.risk: adds a second sampling error and needs careful clock order

candidate_options.name: bottom_plate_or_delayed_latch_clock
candidate_options.purpose: separate sampling switch turn-off from the latch regenerative edge
candidate_options.risk: can reduce one kickback path while increasing another if timing is wrong

candidate_options.name: tiny_input_pair_plus_preamplification
candidate_options.purpose: keep latch input capacitance low while restoring enough signal before regeneration
candidate_options.risk: the preamp may spend more energy and introduce input-referred offset

claim_boundary.allowed: converts measured latch kickback failures into the isolation reduction target for the next Sky130 comparator circuit
claim_boundary.not_allowed: does not prove an isolated comparator, comparator noise, mismatch, SAR conversion, extracted layout, DRC/LVS signoff, or accepted replacement economics

next_acceptance_tests.name: kickback_margin
next_acceptance_tests.requirement: worst sampled differential kickback <= 1.098632813e-04 V target and must be below 2.197265625e-04 V hard line

next_acceptance_tests.name: resolution_preserved
next_acceptance_tests.requirement: both positive and negative target-edge cases still resolve with correct polarity

next_acceptance_tests.name: budget_connection
next_acceptance_tests.requirement: target-edge input difference remains tied to 0.1530 mV, with 0.1567 mV as the hard comparator budget
